ontology:
Prefix(:=<http://example.org/diff012#>)
Prefix(xsd:=<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>)
Ontology(<http://example.org/diff012>
  EquivalentClasses(:Adult DataSomeValuesFrom(:age DatatypeRestriction(xsd:int xsd:minInclusive "18"^^xsd:int)))
  EquivalentClasses(:IntRange DataSomeValuesFrom(:age xsd:integer))
  DataPropertyAssertion(:age :alice "30"^^xsd:int)
  DataPropertyAssertion(:age :bob "12"^^xsd:int)
)
rationale: Datatype reasoning: alice age 30 ≥ 18 satisfies Adult = ∃age.(int ⊓ [minInclusive 18]); bob age 12 does not. Both 30 and 12 are xsd:int literals, and int ⊑ integer, so both satisfy IntRange = ∃age.integer.
